config.title: System Configuration
config.lead: Manage dynamic application variables, timeouts, attempt limits, and feature toggles in real-time.

recruiterAssistant.label: Herman (recruiter assistant)
recruiterAssistant.description: Show the AI hiring assistant widget for eligible users.

recruiterAssistantRoles.heading: Role access
recruiterAssistantRoles.description: Enable or disable Herman per role.
recruiterAssistantRoles.roleDescription: Whether Herman is enabled for {role} users.

liveTranscript.label: Live transcript
liveTranscript.description: Enable live speech-to-text transcript panel during candidate recordings.

liveTranscriptDefaultExpanded.label: Live transcript expanded by default
liveTranscriptDefaultExpanded.description: Whether the live transcript panel starts expanded by default for candidates.

variableDescriptions.ENABLE_LIVE_TRANSCRIPT: Enable live speech-to-text transcript panel during candidate recordings.
variableDescriptions.LIVE_TRANSCRIPT_DEFAULT_EXPANDED: Whether the live transcript panel starts expanded by default for candidates.
variableDescriptions.MAX_ANSWER_DURATION_SECONDS: Maximum answer recording duration in seconds.
variableDescriptions.ENABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH: Whether Google OAuth sign-in button is shown.
variableDescriptions.ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SHARE_LINKS: Whether candidate-feedback share links are available.
variableDescriptions.DEFAULT_THEME_MODE: Default UI theme mode (system, light, dark).
variableDescriptions.APP_THEME: Active UI color theme preset (innowise, red, blue, purple).
variableDescriptions.RECRUITER_ASSISTANT_ENABLED: Whether Herman (recruiter AI assistant) is enabled org-wide.
variableDescriptions.AI_CANDIDATE_FEEDBACK: Enable automated LLM feedback report generation for candidates upon interview completion.
variableDescriptions.AI_QUESTION_DRAFT_V2: A/B testing switch to enable next-generation heuristic prompts for AI question generation.
variableDescriptions.ENABLE_AI_ANSWER_VALIDATION: Master switch for Whisper media transcription and LLM answer grading workflow.
variableDescriptions.ENABLE_S3_MEDIA_CLEANUP: Master switch for background orphan media cleaning job in AWS S3 or MinIO.

config.forbiddenDesc: You need super_admin privileges to view or edit system configuration.

addModal.title: Add System Variable
addModal.description: Create or override a dynamic configuration variable.

resetModal.title: Reset variable to default?
resetModal.description: This will remove the custom override for {key} and restore system defaults.
